onboarding.welcomeBody: Talk about whatever worried you, made you happy, or upset you today. Vidlun helps you sort through your emotions, put a name to them, and better understand how you’re feeling.
onboarding.privacyOnDevice: Your audio and text are stored only on your phone. Vidlun doesn’t keep them on its servers.
onboarding.micBody: For that, Vidlun needs access to your microphone.
onboarding.legalNote: By tapping “Next,” you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
